control.completeness: These are all statically reachable Continue/BREAK sites in the valid baseline. Both if arms terminate recursively; no loop fall-through and no loop RETURN. Do not infer complete exit coverage from a partial producer list.

baseline_observations.continue: C0 and C1 perform no T write, Reset or EndRoot. Captured original/current facts, disjoint sibling and independent bystander survive; iteration locals are ordinary dependency-free u8 Copies.
baseline_observations.lineage: B0 prior/returned_old is the pre-Change child Copy (37), never replacement (58), constructor-rebuilt current (37 at checkpoint), sibling (146), or bystander (211). after_target is the post-Change current (58). The caller uses both through distinct later writes in the frozen order.
baseline_observations.identity: For each probe invocation, original and bystander are distinct live lexical placements with distinct root/incarnations and two declared children each. Continue and all replace operations preserve those exact root/child incarnations and their physical backing; Change updates current facts, including ancestors, while disjoint facts survive. No root/child rebinding or authority imported from equal bits, field spellings, another original or constructor. Distinct calls have distinct semantic local lifetimes; do NOT demand different numeric stack addresses across nonoverlapping calls.
baseline_observations.storage_observation: At original creation, each Continue boundary, after B0, after the loop and after caller writes, observe the same actual original storage and corresponding declared child placement, with a separate bystander. No ABI offset/size claim beyond the source type; public lineage proof and native address evidence have separate limits.
